cases.title: A 5000-character saved filename keeps the image and controls reachable in both themes

limits: Native will-download+setSavePath determines the test destination; no installed Mac default Save dialog acceptance.
No raw Files JSON download/geometry attachment; claims derive from preserved source assertions and report results.
Renderer request observer starts after admission; no claim of complete main/provider network audit.
Same-owner test preserves zoom/src, not nonzero pan.
